When up to six [[Fleshling]]s are spawned in a short period of time, there is a few seconds of cooldown before it can spawn anything again. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|This enemy has already taken quite a beating, but it can take a lot more!
Look out for the giant boss!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 22 (Formerly, [[Polluted Wasteland II|Nuclear]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Amalgamation''' is an enemy that exclusively appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a high amount of health and an average speed. It has one ability, when it takes damage, it will spawn up to six [[Fleshling]]s. It will also emit blood particles when it spawns a [[Fleshling]]. The '''Amalgamation''' replaces the [[Giant Boss]] in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. The '''Amalgamation''' also has the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], which makes stuns only slow it down instead of fully stopping it, prevents it from being knocked back and makes it immune to being frozen or chilled. Its legacy version available in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] only does not have [[Freeze Immunity]]. The '''Amalgamation''' used to be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]] when it used its ''Nuclear Summon'' ability. This means it could also appear in [[Oops! All slimes!]], if spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. It also could have been spawned by the [[Mystery Boss]] before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]. ==Appearance== The '''Amalgamation''' is a mutated, hulking and faceless humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has a light red skin color and black pants. It has a bear trap shackled around its right leg and a larger bear trap fitted around its neck. It has multiple clumps of flesh and smaller humanoids on its torso and arms. ==Mutation== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |750 |- !Wave !Health |- |16 |15,750 |- |17 |16,500 |- |18 |17,250 |- |19 |18,000 |- |20 |18,750 |- |21 |19,500 |- |22 |20,250 |- |23 |21,000 |- |24 |21,750 |- |25 |22,500 |} ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Turret]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended to take down the '''Amalgamation'''. **Be aware that if the [[Accelerator]]s locks on to the '''Amalgamation''', the [[Fleshling]]s that it spawns will get past the [[Accelerator]]. Due to this, placing other towers like the [[Engineer]] to kill them is highly recommended while the [[Accelerator]]s focus on killing the '''Amalgamation'''. *The [[Commander]] can be very useful at boosting the firerate of towers, making them deal more damage against the '''Amalgamation''' and its [[Fleshling]]s. *Slowdown towers can be useful against this, though it has multiple immunities making it harder to slow down. **Freeze and chillness is completely ineffective against it, as it has the [[Freeze Immunity]]. **Due to its [[Stun Immunity]], it cannot be knocked back and stuns only slow it down instead of stunning it. **It also spawns as a [[Boss]] enemy when it first spawns, making it immune to even more stalls, such as the [[DJ Booth]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Jester]] confusion and a stronger immunity to stun slowdown. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseAmal.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NuclearPI2.jpg|'''Amalgamation''' in a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Amalgation''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexAmalgamation.png|'''Amalgamation''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Amalgamation''', despite never being intended to appear in a server with more than four players, has [[MEGA Servers]] health scaling. It increases its health by 150 for every player after 4 players. **This is most likely carried over from the original [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]], which also increased its health by 150. **Interestingly, the '''Amalgamation's''' [[Fleshling]]s, despite being an enemy unique to [[Polluted Wasteland II]] have the same health scaling as the '''Amalgamation'''. This was also most likely carried over from the original [[Amalgamation (Polluted Wasteland)|Amalgamation]]. *The [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] used to improperly call this enemy a [[Giant Boss]]. **This is because the [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]]'s dialogue for [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode was not changed in [[Polluted Wasteland II]] before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Amalgamation''' added. *'''7 April 2023''' - [[v1.7.0]] **[[Stun Immunity]] added. *'''10 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be attacked by towers. *'''11 May 2024''' - [[v1.21.0|v1.21.2]] **{{Bugfix}} Can now can be attacked by towers. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] ** {{Bug}} Spawned [[Fleshling]]s in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode are invisible without the [[Legacy]] modifier. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes are applied to the legacy version. **Health increased from 8,000 to 10,000. **Now gives {{Money|6,250}} every 25% health. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 10,000 to 15,000. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Splitter]]|Wave 13|[[Fleshling]] & Amalgamation|Wave 15|[[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]]|Wave 16}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]] {{DISPLAYTITLE:Amalgamation}}
